Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Mohan Apte. I am a 41-year-old railway employee living in Nashik. Bhavana Bhatt gave me a cheque for ₹16,20,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque came back with the remark account closed. My case number is S.C.C. No. 2600/2023 in the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Nashik. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 65233 28021 or email mohan.apte@example.in.
